messages.plaintextBody:
Rachel, David,

First draft of the Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement attached, together with the amended articles and investors' rights agreement under separate cover. Look forward to your mark-up.

James

messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up attached (clause 9 mainly). In summary: founder cap to £1,000,000; de minimis to £15,000 and basket to £150,000; general warranty survival to 24 months; and we've added a board-papers lead-time in clause 6. We'll send comments on the articles separately.

Mostly mechanical — call if useful.

David Lin
Hargrove & Associates LLP
